components.name: Image Intensifier Tube (Primary Module)
components.reasoning: This is a critical core component that converts ambient light into an intensified image visible through the goggles. It is always procured as a complete subassembly due to its complex internal components and high technical specifications.

components.name: Infrared Camera Module
components.reasoning: Essential for infrared functionality, it captures thermal images in low-light conditions, typically supplied as a fully assembled module with necessary optics and sensors.

components.name: Optical Viewing System (Eyepiece)
components.reasoning: This subassembly provides the user interface by directing the intensified or thermal images to the viewer's eye. It is separate from other components and widely procured as an interchangeable module.

components.name: Electronic Control Unit (ECU)
components.reasoning: Houses circuitry for processing signals between the image intensifier/infrared camera and display elements, enabling functionality and integration with external systems like thermal imagers or communication devices.

components.name: Housing and Enclosure
components.reasoning: Serves as a physical protective structure containing all internal components while providing comfort and durability for the operator. It is often manufactured separately due to its role in housing critical subassemblies.

components.name: Environmental Protection (Sealing System)
components.reasoning: Ensures watertight and dustproof sealing, a distinct component as it involves specific gaskets, seals, and waterproof coatings necessary for the overall functioning of the goggles in various environmental conditions.

components.name: Power Supply Module
components.reasoning: Provides voltage regulation and conditioning for all electronic components, typically a separate unit to ensure proper power delivery while reducing heat generation and increasing reliability.

components.name: Cooling System (Liquid or Peltier)
components.reasoning: Necessary for maintaining operational temperatures within the image intensifier tube, often designed as an integrated system but can be configured separately in certain designs requiring high thermal management capabilities.

The dual-band capability (infrared and visible light) ensures maximum visibility in various environmental conditions, while the monocular design balances user interface and practical operational use.

components.name: PIR Sensor Module
components.reasoning: The PIR sensor is a key component that detects thermal energy to enhance image clarity in night vision applications, typically procured as a separate unit.

components.name: Near-Infrared (NIR) Filter Lens
components.reasoning: This lens filters harmful light while allowing near-infrared wavelengths to pass through for clear nighttime visibility; it is a distinct component with its own supply chain.

components.name: Low-Light Image Intensifier Tube

components.name: Optics Module (Binoculars)
